videos.title: Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year
videos.description: Harpreet Singh Bedi has just graduated, and his marks are a little embarrassing, but marks never stopped him from dreaming of an exciting and adventurous career, and they never will. It is the sometimes thoughtless, sometimes thoughtful story of a fresh graduate trying to find a balance between the maddening demands of the 'professional' way, and the way of his heart.

videos.title: Kaagaz 2
videos.description: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies.

videos.title: Total Siyapaa
videos.description: A guy's plans to impress his Indian girlfriend's parents fall apart when they discover that he is Pakistani.

videos.title: Duplicate
videos.description: An escaped prisoner attempts to assume the identity of his lookalike, an unsuspecting chef, so he can evade the law and seek vengeance on those who double-crossed him.

videos.title: Hum Kisi Se Kum Nahin
videos.description: While attacking one of his enemies, Munna Bhai, a criminal from Mumbai, sees Komal and is so taken by her beauty that he starts thinking about her wherever he goes.

videos.title: Student of the Year 2
videos.description: Rohan follows his lover, Mridula, to St Teresa's college hoping to reunite with her. There, he befriends Manav, the most popular student, but is constantly at loggerheads with his sister, Shreya.

videos.title: Badrinath Ki Dulhania
videos.description: When the son of a wealthy man meets a woman at a wedding, sparks fly between them. While he wants nothing more than to marry her, she wants to pursue her dream of becoming an air hostess.

videos.title: Pyaar Kiya To Darna Kya
videos.description: Muskaan's over-protective brother, Vishal, does not approve of her love for Suraj. Will Suraj be able to convince Vishal of his true love for her?

videos.title: Jab We Met
videos.description: A depressed, wealthy businessman finds his life changing after he meets a spunky and care-free young woman.

videos.title: Khatta Meetha
videos.description: A seemingly corrupt petty contractor faces challenges from the local municipality, his family, his employees, as well as a former girlfriend and her family.

videos.title: Darr
videos.description: Beautiful college girl Kiran Awasthi finds herself caught between two admirers: the dangerously obsessive Rahul Mehra and brave naval officer Sunil Malhotra. Rahul will stop at nothing to win Kiran - even murder - but she is already engaged to Sunil and, following their marriage, the battle between love and life intensifies with frightening consequences.

videos.title: Naa Saami Ranga
videos.description: Three brothers brought together by chance navigate their love lives while jealousy from village elders brews.

videos.title: Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya
videos.description: Pampered since childhood, Ria is used to getting what she wants. But when she falls for a man whom she can never have, desperation sinks its fangs into her sanity.

videos.title: Luka Chuppi
videos.description: A television reporter and a politician's headstrong daughter decide to try out a live-in relationship during a 20-day business trip, but things get complicated when the whole traditional family joins in.

videos.title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
videos.description: Student Naina is good friends with her classmate, skirt-chaser Rohit. Her home life is rife with family tensions as her widowed mum's restaurant runs into difficulties. When charismatic Aman moves into the neighbourhood, he changes everyone's lives, bringing a breath of fresh air, and although he loses his heart to Naina, Aman has a secret that prevents him from marrying her.

videos.title: Partner
videos.description: Prem is a seasoned love guru with a strict moral code. Bhaskar is a quirky office worker with a good heart but no game. It is like a three-ring circus when one tries to train the other in the art of romance.

videos.title: Queen
videos.description: A Delhi girl from a traditional family sets out on a solo honeymoon after her marriage gets cancelled.

videos.title: War 2
videos.description: Driven by his own demons, India's most lethal agent goes after an agent who went rogue years ago.

videos.title: Agneepath
videos.description: The evil and sadistic Kaancha hangs Vijay's father to death. Vijay grows up with a single aim of avenging his father's death. The story surrounds Vijay Chauhan, his relationships with his family and above all, his revenge.

videos.title: Beta
videos.description: After the death of his mother, Raju's father re-marries, but his stepmother is only after the family's money. When Raju eventually marries, his wife tries to make him realise what kind of woman his stepmother is.

videos.title: Action Replay
videos.description: Fed-up with his parents constantly fighting, a young boy goes back in time to make his parents fall in love. This leads to hilarious situations.

videos.title: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
videos.description: A slim uneducated guy is pressured into an arranged marriage with an overweight college girl. The mismatched couple is challenged to compete in the annual wife-carrying race.

videos.title: Chandni
videos.description: Rohit and Chandni become engaged in spite of their families' refusal, based on their class differences, but when Rohit loses the function of his legs in a road accident, he leaves Chandni rather than placing a burden on her. Years later, Rohit has made a full recovery, and sets out to find Chandni, but when he does, she is engaged to another man.

videos.title: Badhaai Ho
videos.description: A 25-year-old man tries to suppress his embarrassment when his mother announces that she is pregnant.

videos.title: War
videos.description: In a high-stakes clash of wits, bullets, and loyalties, Capt. Khalid squares up to his ex-mentor, Major Kabir, who was considered the team's ace before having gone rogue.
